description: This Java class defines an AmqpTarget that encapsulates a JMS Destination for messaging purposes. It includes methods for creating targets based on a string address and overrides equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

classes.name: AmqpTarget
classes.description: A final class representing a messaging destination for AMQP using JMS. Implements PublishTarget interface and provides methods for creation and comparison.

methods.name: fromTargetAddress
methods.description: Creates an AmqpTarget instance from a string address, determining if it is a topic or queue based on prefixes.

methods.name: getJmsDestination
methods.description: Returns the JMS Destination associated with this target.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare based on the underlying JMS destination.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Overrides Object.hashCode to generate hash based on the JMS destination.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the AmqpTarget.
